Backend: activity_metrics contains activity_level (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Improvement/Inactive)

Backend: All metric weights sum to 100%

Backend: lessons metric has published count
Backend: plans metric has approval_rate
Backend: clock_hours metric has hours_30d and total_hours
Backend: grading metric has graded, total_submissions, rate

critical_code_review_comments: Activity metrics scoring system correctly implements 7 weighted metrics: lessons (20%), assignments (15%), plans (15%), files (10%), clock_hours (20%), grading (10%), platform_activity (10%)
Activity level labels correctly map to score ranges: Excellent (80-100), Good (60-79), Fair (40-59), Needs Improvement (20-39), Inactive (0-19)
Management comments CRUD properly implements role-based access control - only MONITOR_ROLES can create/delete/pin comments
Comment pinning correctly toggles state and pinned comments are sorted first in the list
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
